title: Traditional Ukrainian Dough Dumplings
description: Homemade Ukrainian-style dough dumplings are an easy and delicious addition to any meal. These chewy dumplings are perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use all-purpose flour for the best results

ingredients.name: warm water
ingredients.notes: warm water helps the dough come together

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: for brushing the dumplings with oil

ingredients.name: dough (for dumplings)
ingredients.notes: use homemade or store-bought dough for the dumplings

instructions: Combine the flour, warm water, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Mix the dough until it comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of your favorite filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with vegetable oil.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Gently add the dumplings to the boiling water.
Cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
